# squn

> Type-safe SQL query library for Bun. Supports SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MSSQL with a unified API, no codegen, and zero magic.

- Package: `@phonemyatt/squn`
- Runtime: Bun 1.x only (uses bun:sqlite, Bun.sql)
- License: MIT
- Install: `bun add @phonemyatt/squn`
- MSSQL also needs: `bun add mssql`

## Core concept

All queries go through the `sql` tagged template literal. Interpolated values always become bound parameters — never concatenated into SQL text. SQL injection is structurally impossible.

```typescript
import { createConnection, SqliteAdapter, sql } from "@phonemyatt/squn";

const db = createConnection(new SqliteAdapter({ filename: "app.db" }));
const users = await db.query<User>(sql`SELECT * FROM users WHERE age > ${18}`);
```

## Adapters

| Database   | Adapter           | Connection string format                          |
|------------|-------------------|---------------------------------------------------|
| SQLite     | SqliteAdapter     | `{ filename: "app.db" }` or `{ filename: ":memory:" }` |
| PostgreSQL | PostgresAdapter   | `{ url: "postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/db" }`  |
| MySQL      | MysqlAdapter      | `{ url: "mysql://user:pass@host:3306/db" }`       |
| MSSQL      | MssqlAdapter      | `{ url: "mssql://sa:pass@host:1433/db" }` or individual fields |

All four adapters implement `IDbAdapter`. Swap adapters without changing query code.

## Query methods

```typescript
// All rows
const rows = await db.query<T>(sql`SELECT ...`);

// First row or null
const row = await db.queryFirst<T>(sql`SELECT ...`);

// Exactly one row — throws QueryError if 0 or 2+
const row = await db.querySingle<T>(sql`SELECT ...`);

// First column of first row
const count = await db.queryScalar<number>(sql`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users`);

// Multiple result sets (MSSQL stored procs)
const [users, roles] = await db.queryMultiple(sqlRaw("EXEC GetUsersAndRoles"));

// Streaming — does not load all rows into memory
for await (const row of db.stream<T>(sql`SELECT ...`)) { ... }
```

## Execute methods

```typescript
// Single write
const { rowsAffected } = await db.execute(sql`UPDATE ...`);

// Batch — same SQL, many rows (single prepared statement)
await db.executeBatch(
  sql`INSERT INTO users (name, age) VALUES (@name, @age)`,
  [{ name: "Alice", age: 30 }, { name: "Bob", age: 25 }],
);
```

## SQL helpers

```typescript
import { sql, sqlRaw, sqlIdentifier, sqlQualifiedIdentifier, sqlIf, sqlJoin } from "@phonemyatt/squn";

// Nested fragment — placeholders renumbered automatically
const filter = sql`age > ${18}`;
const q = sql`SELECT * FROM users WHERE ${filter}`;

// Literal SQL — no params, do not pass user input
const ddl = sqlRaw("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS logs (id SERIAL)");

// Safe identifier quoting — throws on invalid chars
sqlIdentifier("user_name")                   // → "user_name"
sqlQualifiedIdentifier("public", "users")    // → "public"."users"

// Conditional fragment
sqlIf(condition, sql`AND role = ${"admin"}`);

// Join fragments
sqlJoin([sql`age > ${18}`, sql`active = ${true}`], " AND ");
```

## Transactions

```typescript
// Recommended — auto commit/rollback
await db.atomically(async (q) => {
  await q.execute(sql`UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance - ${100} WHERE id = ${1}`);
  await q.execute(sql`UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance + ${100} WHERE id = ${2}`);
});

// Manual control
await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
  await tx.execute(sql`...`);
  // commits on return, rolls back on throw
});

// await using — rolls back automatically if still ACTIVE when disposed
await using tx = new Transaction(await adapter.beginTransaction());
await tx.execute(sql`...`);
await tx.commit();

// Savepoints
await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
  const sp = await tx.savepoint();
  try { await tx.execute(sql`...`); }
  catch { await sp.rollback(); }
  await sp.release();
});

// Deadlock retry
import { retryWithDeadlockBackoff } from "@phonemyatt/squn";
await retryWithDeadlockBackoff(() => db.atomically(async (q) => { ... }), "postgres");

// Isolation level
import { IsolationLevel } from "@phonemyatt/squn";
adapter.setIsolationLevel(IsolationLevel.SERIALIZABLE);
```

## Prepared queries

Parse and validate once at startup, bind cheaply on every call:

```typescript
import { prepare } from "@phonemyatt/squn";

const findUser = prepare<User, { id: number }>(
  adapter,
  sql`SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ${0}`,
  ["id"],
);

const user  = await findUser.first({ id: 42 });   // → User | null
const users = await findUser.all({ id: 42 });     // → User[]
const exact = await findUser.single({ id: 42 });  // → User (throws on 0 or 2+)
```

## Multi-connection

```typescript
import { createConnections, PostgresAdapter } from "@phonemyatt/squn";

const db = createConnections({
  connections: {
    primary: new PostgresAdapter({ url: process.env.PG_PRIMARY }),
    replica: new PostgresAdapter({ url: process.env.PG_REPLICA }),
  },
  default: "primary",
});

await db.query<User>(sql`SELECT * FROM users`, { connection: "replica" });

const replica = db.use("replica"); // scoped — no connection option needed
const [users, roles] = await db.concurrent(
  db.query<User>(sql`SELECT * FROM users`),
  db.query<Role>(sql`SELECT * FROM roles`),
);
```

## Result mapping

```typescript
import { defineMapper, MapperRegistry, Entity, globalMapperRegistry } from "@phonemyatt/squn";

// Functional
const mapUser = defineMapper<User>((row) => ({
  id:        row.id as number,
  name:      row.name as string,
  createdAt: new Date(row.created_at as string),
}));

// Decorator
@Entity({
  id:   (row) => row.id as number,
  name: (row) => row.name as string,
})
class User { constructor(public id: number, public name: string) {} }
const mapper = globalMapperRegistry.get(User);

// Nested JOIN mapping — deduplicates by primary key
import { splitAndMap } from "@phonemyatt/squn";
const posts = splitAndMap(rows, ["author_id"], [mapPost, mapAuthor]);
```

## Validation decorators (for @Entity classes)

```typescript
import { NotNull, Email, Min, Max } from "@phonemyatt/squn";

class User {
  @NotNull name: string;
  @Email   email: string;
  @Min(0) @Max(150) age: number;
}
```

## Error handling

All errors extend `SqunError` with a structured `.context` object:

```typescript
import { SqunError, QueryError, ErrorCode } from "@phonemyatt/squn";

try {
  await db.query(sql`SELECT * FROM nonexistent`);
} catch (err) {
  if (err instanceof SqunError) {
    err.code             // ErrorCode enum value
    err.context.adapter  // "postgres" | "mysql" | "mssql" | "sqlite"
    err.context.sql      // the SQL that failed
  }
}
```

Error classes: `QueryError`, `TransactionError`, `ConnectionError`, `ValidationError`, `SecurityError`, `TimeoutError`, `AuthError`, `MappingError`, `AdapterError`, `SqunConfigError`.

## Type inference

```typescript
import { col, defineTable, InferSelect, InferInsert } from "@phonemyatt/squn";

const Users = defineTable({
  id:   col("integer").primaryKey().notNull(),
  name: col("text").notNull(),
  age:  col("integer").nullable(),
});

type UserRow    = InferSelect<typeof Users>;  // { id: number; name: string; age: number | null }
type UserInsert = InferInsert<typeof Users>;  // { name: string; age?: number | null }
```

## Configuration

```typescript
const db = createConnection(adapter, {
  environment: "production",
  pool:     { min: 2, max: 10, acquireTimeoutMs: 5_000 },
  timeout:  { queryMs: 30_000, transactionMs: 60_000 },
  log:      { logger: consoleLogger, level: "info" },
  security: { blockRawSql: true, detectInjection: true },
});
```

Loggers: `consoleLogger`, `jsonLogger`, `noopLogger` (default). Implement `SqunLogger` for custom integrations.

Environment variable auto-discovery:
- `SQUN_PG_URL` — PostgreSQL connection URL
- `SQUN_MYSQL_URL` — MySQL connection URL
- `SQUN_MSSQL_URL` — MSSQL connection URL
- `SQUN_DB_FILE` — SQLite file path
- `SQUN_ENV` — `development` | `test` | `production`

## Key constraints and caveats

- Bun runtime only — does not work with Node.js
- `sqlRaw()` must never receive user input — it bypasses parameterisation
- `querySingle()` throws if the result set is not exactly one row
- `executeBatch()` uses `@name` style placeholders (not `$N` or `?`)
- MSSQL adapter uses the `mssql` npm package; the other three use Bun built-ins
- `sql` template literals produce `SqlFragment` objects — pass them directly to `db.*` methods
